ideas.idea: Use Link for /features instead of onClick div (note in report)
ideas.why: This is the known problem of /features being reached only by a div, restated, though it is accurate.

ideas.idea: Add /features to the main nav in root.tsx
ideas.why: The nav lists only Pricing and Changelog, so a real link to /features would fix discovery and is accurate to root.tsx.

ideas.idea: Name the actual integrations in the home page text
ideas.why: The home page says 'Integrates with all the tools you already use' with no names, so naming them gives readers and machines something concrete.

ideas.idea: Put concrete plan names and prices on /pricing, possibly with Offer structured data
ideas.why: The pricing page only says 'Talk to us for a quote', so plan details are missing and could be added as text (Offer markup is optional).
This is accurate, but with four URLs and no date source in the repo it has little effect.
No JSON-LD is a deliberate choice that is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and og tags in root meta
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site, and the og:image suggestion has no matching asset in the repo.

ideas.idea: Give each changelog entry its own page/URL
ideas.why: The changelog is a single list, so per-release URLs would be linkable and citable, which fits this repo.

ideas.idea: Expand features page with per-feature headings and descriptions
ideas.why: features.tsx has a single one-line paragraph, so per-feature headings and detail would give more to read and quote.

ideas.idea: Move changelog fetch into a Remix loader (note)
ideas.why: This restates the known useEffect changelog problem.
